name: io.github.air-catfish/beesum-min
description: Transcript-first YouTube summarizer: download subtitles, keep the transcript local, or summarize through a configured provider.

environmentVariables.name: BEESUM_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: LLM provider for the summarize tools: transcript-only (default, only get_transcript is offered), ollama, openai-compatible, anthropic or gemini.

environmentVariables.name: BEESUM_SUB_LANGS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated subtitle languages to download, for example ru,en.

environmentVariables.name: BEESUM_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Proxy URL passed to yt-dlp, for example socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. May contain credentials.

environmentVariables.name: BEESUM_OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server.

environmentVariables.name: BEESUM_OLLAMA_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama model name used when BEESUM_PROVIDER is ollama.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key that enables the OpenAI-compatible provider.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key that enables the Anthropic provider.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key that enables the Gemini provider.
